# Alex Marlowe — Creative Developer & Designer

> Portfolio of Alex Marlowe, creative developer & designer based in Oslo, Norway.
> The site is a single-page experience: boot preloader, glitch hero, about + certificates,
> art-direction project archive, photography archive with polaroids, a 12-face holo-cube
> illustration gallery and a terminal-style contact form.

## Sections
- Hero: identity, availability, navigation hints
- About: bio, availability, certificates gallery (9 items)
- Work: identity / editorial / web project tables with previews
- Photography: 52 frames across landscapes, street, animals, travel + 10 polaroids
- Illustration: contact sheet + holo-cube gallery (12 works)
- Contact: demo-mode form, direct mail link

## Tech
Hand-written HTML/CSS/JS, GSAP + ScrambleTextPlugin, Splitting.js, ScrollOut.
All imagery is procedurally generated from tools/generate_assets.py — no stock photos.
Bilingual EN/ES, custom cursor, WebAudio UI sounds, no tracking.
